items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Risk severity is high for fleet-wide go-live, new public exposure, and security-sensitive releases; ordinary reversible growth may continue conditionally when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, configuration, tracking, or cross-site behavior. Evidence: fleet-doctor is not OK and has no run, checks, findings, or site results; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error-sweep results; and authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unevidenced. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown. Exact decision: preserve private-launch and security-sensitive release gates; retain only the three bounded revalidations as capacity- and measurement-gated queue work; do not claim clearance, certification, absence of vulnerabilities, or production readiness.

Maintain the existing read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated evidence or explicit unknowns for authentication, access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, request duplicate telemetry, conduct external outreach, or treat missing evidence as a clean result.
